name: 04-deadzone-boot-bd21ce6
description: Camera rebooted at 09:23 in broad daylight with a stale persisted night and a mid-band night-pipeline gain (731, inside the 300..3000 dead-zone). Pre-fix the decision stayed DN_UNKNOWN forever - both reconfirm probes were gated on cur==NIGHT, which UNKNOWN never satisfies - and the camera rendered night video indefinitely with zero log lines. Post-fix: the dead-zone adoption must adopt the persisted night after settle, arm the verify deadline, and the (first-of-session, never-skipped) probe must find day-pipeline gain 250 and stick in day within DN_ADOPT_PROBE_S plus margin.
